mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voice_reference_assets (id, account_id, storage_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, status) VALUES (#{command.proposedId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.assets.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.MediaAssetUuidTypeHandler}, #{accountId}, #{command.storageKey}, #{command.originalFilename}, #{command.contentType}, #{command.sizeBytes}, #{checksum}, 'VALIDATING') ON CONFLICT (account_id, sha256) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, storage_key, original_filename, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, status FROM voice_reference_assets WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND sha256 = #{sha256} AND status <> 'DELETED'
